info.title: ForteBank video analysis API
info.description: Contract only; handlers are not implemented. Default job view satisfies the jury's required full JPEG/base64 result. view=ui supplies local-LLM overview and backend-defined progress; events are paginated and frames fetched separately. Both views are projections of the same immutable result, not separate analyses. Examples are synthetic. Cross-field invariants documented in api-contract.md must also be implemented by the server; Zod refinements are not represented in JSON Schema.

get.description: Authenticated aggregate readiness check, not job progress. backend=ok means the API can accept and persist jobs; gpu_server=ok requires a responsive GPU worker, usable GPU and loaded analysis/LLM models. Probe both independently with a 2-second budget; do not run inference. UI polls every 10 seconds through the same-origin proxy, which times out after 3 seconds. If the backend is unreachable, the proxy returns 503 HealthResponse with backend=error and gpu_server=unknown; it must not assert GPU failure. Health 503 uses the health body, not ApiErrorResponse. No query parameters. No cached success.

Cache-Control.description: Do not cache video analysis responses or frames.

post.summary: Upload one MOV and create a job
post.description: Authenticate before reading the upload. Return 202 after persisting it, without waiting for inference. Repeated POST creates another job; do not retry automatically. Processing, local LLM overview and result publication share the five-minute deadline, measured from upload receipt start.

requestBody.description: One nonempty .mov file, at most 104857600 bytes. Verify container and video stream. Accept generic or absent part MIME for a valid MOV.

202.description: Accepted and persisted; no verdict yet.

Location.description: Job resource; UI clients append view=ui.

get.summary: Get state and result in jury or UI representation
get.description: view=jury (default) returns JuryJobResponse, including all events with JPEG/base64 on done. view=ui returns JobResponse: progress for every state, overview and violations_count only on done, never inline events or frames. Stage IDs, display labels, descriptions, ordered plan and percentages are determined by the backend. done and failed are terminal. Both views have the same job_id, status and verdict. A failed job is HTTP 200. Unknown/repeated view, or page/page_size on this endpoint, return 400; paginate via /violations.

200.description: Select response schema by view. No query means JuryJobResponse.

get.summary: Paginated event timecodes, descriptions, rules and frame references
get.description: Only available on done. Order by (timecode_sec ascending, id ascending ASCII) is stable across pages of the immutable snapshot. Pages are 1-based; default page_size=20, maximum 100. Empty results or pages beyond the end return 200 with items=[]. total counts all events and equals UI violations_count. There are no inline image bytes. Rules are embedded in each event; there is no /rules endpoint. Cross-field checks: exact page length, unique event IDs, chronological order, unique frame IDs per event.

get.summary: Load one evidence JPEG on demand
get.description: Only available on done. Authenticate and check job ownership before resolving event/frame IDs. Returns the same JPEG bytes as the corresponding jury base64 frame. A frame from another event/job is never served. Browser clients use the same-origin session-protected proxy; do not put API keys in URLs.
